name: Delta-sarcoglycan-related limb-girdle muscular dystrophy R6

ethnicAssociations: Reported in diverse ethnic groups including European and Middle Eastern populations

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic criteria for limb-girdle muscular dystrophies

criteria.description: Progressive proximal muscle weakness predominantly affecting limb-girdle muscles
Muscle biopsy showing dystrophic changes with reduced or absent delta-sarcoglycan protein expression
Identification of pathogenic mutations in the SGCD gene encoding delta-sarcoglycan

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive proximal limb-girdle muscle weakness with supportive muscle biopsy findings and confirmation by genetic testing of SGCD mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Differentiation from other LGMD subtypes requires comprehensive genetic and immunohistochemical analysis.

laboratory: Normal or mildly elevated inflammatory markers
imaging: Muscle MRI showing selective fatty replacement and muscle atrophy in proximal limb muscles
Echocardiography may reveal cardiomyopathy or conduction defects
other: Muscle biopsy with dystrophic changes and immunohistochemistry demonstrating absent or reduced delta-sarcoglycan

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of sarcoglycan deficiency on muscle biopsy
Typically earlier onset with calf hypertrophy

references: Nigro V, Savarese M. Genetic basis of limb-girdle muscular dystrophies: the 2022 update. Neuromuscul Disord. 2022;32(1):1-12.
